ABOUT THIS SCRIPT

This script reads in the clean dataset from data folder, converts and inflates currencies to 2023 USD, and then runs fits a Bayesian generalized multivariate multilevel model on the various reported patient costs.

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
##############################################################################|
##### LOAD IN NECESSARY PACKAGES ##############################################
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(here)
library(magrittr)
library(DT)
library(metafor)
library(meta)
library(brms)
library(scales)
library(tidybayes)
library(ggplot2)
library(priceR)

# expit <- function (x) {exp(x)/(1 + exp(x))}

myPal <- c("black", "violet")

##############################################################################|
##### LOAD IN CLEAN LINE LISTED DATASET #######################################
dataList <- readRDS(here("data/tempCleanData.rds"))

```

We would like to update all currencies to 2024 USD. Because inflation occurs at different rates per country, we will convert to local currency, then inflate to 2024, then convert to USD. 

### Convert to local currencies 

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Read in conversion factors
cnvsFctrFromUSD <- readRDS(here("data/fromUSDconversionFactors.rds"))
cnvsFctrFromUSD <- cbind(dataList[["descriptive"]]$covidence.id,
                  cnvsFctrFromUSD)
colnames(cnvsFctrFromUSD)[1] <- "covidence.id"
cnvsFctrFromUSD <- as.data.frame(cnvsFctrFromUSD)
### Apply to all costs reported 
costs0 <- cbind(dataList[["data"]]$covidence.id,
                   (dataList[["data"]] %>% select(starts_with(c("de", "dme", "dmne", "ie"))))[,-1])

colnames(costs0)[1] <- "covidence.id"

costs <- left_join(costs0, cnvsFctrFromUSD)

costLocal <- costs[,c(-1,-992)]

for(i in 1:nrow(costLocal)){
    costLocal[i,] <- as.numeric(unlist(costs[i,c(-1,-992)])) * as.numeric(costs[i,992])
}

# plot(costLocal$de.prediag.median, col="green")
# points(costs$de.prediag.median, col="darkgreen")
```

### Inflate local currencies 2024

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Read in inflation factors
infltnFctr <- readRDS(here("data/inflationLocalFactors.rds"))
infltnFctr <- cbind(dataList[["descriptive"]]$covidence.id,
                  infltnFctr)
colnames(infltnFctr)[1] <- "covidence.id"
infltnFctr <- as.data.frame(infltnFctr)

costs <- left_join(costs, infltnFctr)

### Apply to all reported costs 
costLocalInflate <- costLocal
for(i in 1:nrow(costLocal)){
    costLocalInflate[i,] <- as.numeric(unlist(costLocal[i,]))*as.numeric(costs[i,"infltnFctr"])
}

# plot(costLocalInflate$de.prediag.median, col="green")
# points(costLocal$de.prediag.median, col="darkgreen")

```

### Convert from 2024 local currencies to 2024 USD

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Read in conversion factors and format 
cnvsFctrToUSD <- readRDS(here("data/toUSDconversionFactors.rds"))
cnvsFctrToUSD <- cbind(dataList[["descriptive"]]$covidence.id,
                  cnvsFctrToUSD)
colnames(cnvsFctrToUSD)[1] <- "covidence.id"
cnvsFctrToUSD <- as.data.frame(cnvsFctrToUSD)


### Apply to all costs reported 
costs <- left_join(costs, cnvsFctrToUSD)

costsUSD24 <- costLocalInflate

for(i in 1:nrow(costLocalInflate)){
    costsUSD24[i,] <- as.numeric(unlist(costLocalInflate[i,])) * as.numeric(costs[i,"cnvsFctrToUSD"])
}


# plot(costLocalInflate$de.prediag.median, col="green")
# points(costsUSD24$de.prediag.median, col="darkgreen")

### Add in the covidence id and study countries back in 
costsUSD24 <- cbind(costs[,1], costsUSD24); colnames(costsUSD24)[1] <- "covidence.id"
costsUSD24 <- left_join(costsUSD24, dataList[["descriptive"]])
```

### Create plots of the collected currencies 
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
ggplot(data = costsUSD24 %>% filter(as.numeric(dme.tbcare.total.mean) < 50000)) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=covidence.id, y=as.numeric(dme.tbcare.total.mean)), color = "springgreen2", size=3) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=covidence.id, y=as.numeric(dme.tbcare.total.median)), color = "springgreen4", size=3) + 
    theme_minimal(base_size = 30) + coord_flip()

ggplot(data = costsUSD24 %>% filter(as.numeric(dme.tbcare.total.mean) < 50000)) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=study.country, y=as.numeric(dme.tbcare.total.mean, group=study.country)), color = "springgreen2", size=3) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=study.country, y=as.numeric(dme.tbcare.total.median, group=study.country)), color = "springgreen4", size=3) + 
    # facet_grid(rows = vars(study.country)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 30) + coord_flip()
```
